recipes.title: 村驴版糖醋排骨
steps: 排骨冷水浸泡30分钟，控干水分，用厨房纸吸干表面。
调料汁：60克冰糖、30克白醋、40克生抽、4克老抽、30克番茄酱混匀。
热锅少油爆香姜片，下排骨煎至表面金黄，烹1勺料酒。
倒入料汁翻匀，加入没过排骨的热水。大火煮开撇沫，盖盖转小火焖45至60分钟，至排骨软烂、熟透。
开盖大火收汁，最后沿锅边再淋少许白醋，撒白芝麻出锅。
recipes.note: 按你提供的截图整理。100分钟包含浸泡与焖煮，实际用时随排骨大小调整。收汁时多翻动，避免糖汁糊锅；白醋30克用于料汁，出锅前另补少许。姜片、料酒用量及份数为参考。

en.title: Sweet & sour pork ribs
ingredients: White vinegar 30g (plus a little to finish)
steps: Soak ribs in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and pat completely dry with kitchen paper.
Mix 60g rock sugar, 30g white vinegar, 40g light soy, 4g dark soy and 30g ketchup.
Sauté ginger in a little oil. Fry ribs until golden and add 1 tbsp cooking wine.
Add the sauce, toss and cover the ribs with hot water. Boil and skim, then cover and simmer for 45–60 minutes until tender and fully cooked.
Uncover and reduce over high heat, stirring often. Finish with a little extra white vinegar and sesame.
en.note: Based on your screenshot. The 100-minute estimate includes soaking and simmering. Stir while reducing to prevent burning. Use 30g vinegar in the sauce and a little extra at the end. Ginger, wine and servings are estimates.

recipes.title: 清炖牛肋条
steps: 牛肋条切大块，清水浸泡30分钟以上，中途换水；白萝卜、洋葱切块，苹果去核。
牛肉冷水入锅，加入葱段、姜片和黄酒，小火煮开，撇去浮沫。捞出后用温水洗净。
白萝卜另入沸水，加少许糖焯水，再捞出备用。
牛肉放入高压锅，加入足量开水、新的葱姜、洋葱和半个苹果。按锅具说明盖盖，上压后小火炖约20分钟。
关火并按锅具说明完全泄压后开盖，加入白萝卜、盐和白胡椒，再上压炖约5分钟；完全泄压后开盖。
撒葱花、香菜。可另调蘸汁：生抽2勺、蚝油1勺、少许糖、葱蒜、小米椒及辣椒油或香油。
recipes.note: 按你提供的截图整理。100分钟为含浸泡、上压与泄压的参考总用时；高压锅以自家锅具说明为准。蘸汁和香菜可选，未计入主食材匹配。

en.title: Clear beef rib & radish soup
steps: Cut the beef into large chunks. Soak in cold water for at least 30 minutes, changing the water. Chop the radish and onion; core the apple.
Start the beef in cold water with spring onion, ginger and rice wine. Bring gently to a boil and skim. Drain and rinse with warm water.
Blanch the radish separately in boiling water with a little sugar, then drain.
Put the beef in a pressure cooker with enough boiling water, fresh ginger and spring onion, onion and half an apple. Follow the cooker instructions; cook for about 20 minutes under pressure.
Turn off the heat and release pressure fully as instructed before opening. Add radish, salt and white pepper; cook under pressure for about 5 more minutes, then release fully before opening.
Finish with spring onion and coriander. Optional dipping sauce: 2 tbsp light soy, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, a little sugar, chopped aromatics, chilli and chilli or sesame oil.
en.note: Based on your screenshot. The 100-minute estimate includes soaking and pressure release. Follow your own cooker instructions. Dipping sauce and coriander are optional and excluded from ingredient matching.

recipes.title: 柠檬手撕鸡
steps: 鸡腿冷水入锅，加入姜片和料酒。水开撇沫，小火煮约20分钟至完全熟透，捞出放凉。
将小米椒、辣椒面、蒜末、白芝麻放入耐热碗，淋少量热油激香。
加入盐、少许鸡精（可选）、糖、生抽、蚝油和香醋，拌匀成料汁。
鸡腿去骨撕成条。柠檬洗净切片去籽，香菜切段。
将鸡丝、柠檬、香菜和料汁拌匀，静置几分钟入味后享用。
recipes.note: 按你提供的截图整理；截图没有明确克数，用量为约2人份的参考。柠檬去籽，避免久泡发苦；辣椒可按口味减量。

en.title: Lemon shredded chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken legs from cold water with ginger and cooking wine. Skim after boiling and cook gently for about 20 minutes until cooked through. Remove and cool.
Put chopped chillies, chilli flakes, minced garlic and sesame in a heatproof bowl. Pour over a little hot oil.
Mix in salt, optional chicken seasoning, sugar, light soy, oyster sauce and vinegar.
Remove the bones and shred the chicken. Wash and slice the lemon, removing seeds. Chop the coriander.
Toss everything with the dressing and leave for a few minutes before serving.
en.note: Based on your screenshot. Quantities are estimates for about two servings. Remove lemon seeds and avoid a long soak to prevent bitterness. Adjust chilli to taste.

recipes.title: 照烧鸡腿排
steps: 鸡腿排擦干，用少许料酒和黑胡椒抓匀，腌制10分钟。保留鸡皮时可在皮上扎几下，减少回缩。
调汁：生抽2勺、蚝油1勺、零卡糖1勺、老抽半勺，加小半碗水拌匀。
平底锅放少量油或不放油，鸡皮朝下小火慢煎，至表皮金黄并出油；去皮鸡腿则用少量油煎。
翻面，加入蒜末和照烧汁，盖盖以中小火焖约3分钟，按肉块厚度延长至完全熟透。
开盖收汁，保留少许汤汁，切块后撒白芝麻和葱花。
recipes.note: 按你提供的截图整理。去皮版本需加少许油；保留鸡皮时可利用其自身油脂。总用时包含10分钟腌制，焖煮时长按肉块厚度调整。

en.title: Teriyaki chicken thigh
steps: Pat the thigh dry and marinate with cooking wine and black pepper for 10 minutes. If keeping the skin, prick it a few times to reduce shrinking.
Mix light soy, oyster sauce, sweetener and dark soy with a small half-bowl of water.
Pan-fry skin-side down over low heat with little or no added oil until golden and the fat renders. Use a little oil for skinless chicken.
Turn over, add minced garlic and sauce. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 minutes, extending as needed until fully cooked.
Uncover and reduce, keeping a little sauce. Slice and finish with sesame and spring onion.
en.note: Based on your screenshot. Use a little oil for skinless chicken, or let skin-on chicken render its own fat. Total time includes a 10-minute marinade; adjust simmering time to the thickness of the meat.

recipes.title: 托斯卡纳三文鱼意面
steps: 三文鱼用厨房纸擦干，临下锅前撒盐、黑胡椒和蒜粉，不要过早腌制。
锅中加入少许日晒番茄里的油，中小火煎三文鱼至两面金黄，盛出备用。
盐水煮意面至al dente，按包装时间调整。捞出前保留两勺面汤。
原锅融化黄油，炒香洋葱末和蒜末，刮起锅底焦香。加番茄膏、小番茄和日晒番茄炒软；可加少许盐和糖。
倒入150毫升淡奶油，小火搅匀；加入牛至、红椒粉、蒜粉、盐和黑胡椒。放入菠菜煮软，再拌入帕玛森芝士。
加入意面和预留的面汤，将三文鱼放回，煮至鱼肉熟透、酱汁浓稠。尝味后调整盐量。
意面铺底，摆上三文鱼，撒帕玛森芝士和欧芹碎。
recipes.note: 按你的文字食谱整理；未给出的克数按约2人份估算。怕腻可用75毫升奶油加75毫升牛奶。30分钟为参考用时；没有提供这道菜的成品图，因此不配无关照片。
recipes.source: 按你的文字食谱整理；未提供成品图片

en.title: Tuscan salmon fettuccine
steps: Pat the salmon dry. Season with salt, black pepper and garlic powder just before cooking.
Heat a little oil from the sun-dried tomato jar. Sear salmon over medium-low heat until golden on both sides, then remove.
Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente according to its package. Reserve two ladles of pasta water.

Melt butter in the same pan. Sauté onion and garlic, scraping up the browned bits. Add tomato paste, cherry tomatoes and sun-dried tomatoes; cook until softened. Add a little salt and sugar if desired.
Stir in 150ml cream over low heat. Season with oregano, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Wilt the spinach, then stir in Parmesan.
Toss in the pasta and reserved water. Return the salmon and gently cook until the fish is cooked through and the sauce coats the pasta. Adjust seasoning.
Plate the pasta and salmon. Finish with Parmesan and chopped parsley.
en.note: Based on your written recipe. Unspecified quantities are estimated for two servings. For a lighter sauce, use 75ml cream and 75ml milk. Thirty minutes is an estimate. No finished-dish photo was supplied.

recipes.title: 清炒菠菜
steps: 菠菜洗净切段，大蒜拍碎。
菠菜入沸水快速焯一下，捞出沥干。
锅中少量油炒香蒜末，加入菠菜大火快炒，以盐调味。
recipes.note: 先沥干再快炒，避免盘底积水。

en.title: Simple spinach stir-fry
steps: Wash and cut the spinach. Crush the garlic.
Briefly blanch the spinach in boiling water and drain well.
Heat a little oil, sauté the garlic and quickly stir-fry the spinach. Season with salt.
en.note: Drain well before stir-frying to keep the dish from becoming watery.

recipes.title: 葱爆五花肉
steps: 五花肉切薄片，大葱斜切段，姜切丝。
锅中少量油下五花肉煸炒至出油、边缘微黄。
加入姜丝和葱白炒香，沿锅边淋料酒和生抽。
放入剩余葱段，大火翻炒至肉片熟透，调盐出锅。
recipes.note: 葱分两次加入，兼顾香味与爽脆。

en.title: Pork belly & spring onion stir-fry
steps: Thinly slice the pork belly, cut spring onions diagonally and shred ginger.
Fry pork in a little oil until fat renders and the edges turn golden.
Add ginger and the white parts of the onions. Splash in cooking wine and light soy.
Add the remaining onions and stir-fry over high heat until the pork is cooked through. Season with salt.
en.note: Add the onions in two batches for both aroma and a fresh crunch.

recipes.title: 小炒黄牛肉
steps: 牛肉逆纹切薄片，用生抽、蚝油、淀粉和少许油拌匀，腌10分钟。
小米椒切圈，姜蒜切末，香菜切段。
热锅下油，将牛肉快速滑炒至变色后盛出。
炒香姜蒜和小米椒，倒回牛肉炒至熟透，关火拌入香菜。
recipes.note: 少量分批炒肉，避免锅温骤降出水。

en.title: Hunan beef stir-fry
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Marinate with soy, oyster sauce, starch and a little oil for 10 minutes.
Chop the chillies, ginger, garlic and coriander.
Sear the beef quickly in hot oil until its surface changes colour, then remove.
Sauté ginger, garlic and chillies. Return beef and cook through, then fold in coriander off the heat.
en.note: Cook the beef in small batches so the pan stays hot.

recipes.title: 农家小炒肉
steps: 五花肉切薄片，青椒去蒂切块，大蒜切片。
青椒不放油先干煸至微起虎皮，盛出。
五花肉下锅煸出油，加入蒜片和豆豉炒香。
倒回青椒，加入生抽和少许老抽，大火翻炒至肉熟透。
recipes.note: 青椒先干煸，香味更集中；豆豉本身有咸味，最后再尝味。

en.title: Hunan farmhouse pork
steps: Thinly slice pork and garlic. Cut peppers into chunks.
Dry-fry the peppers until lightly blistered, then remove.
Fry pork until the fat renders; add garlic and fermented black beans.
Return peppers, add both soy sauces and stir-fry over high heat until the pork is cooked through.
en.note: Blistering peppers first develops flavour. Taste before adding salt because the beans are salty.

recipes.title: 麻婆豆腐
steps: 豆腐切块，用淡盐热水焯一下，沥干；淀粉加水调匀。
肉末下油锅炒熟，加入姜蒜和豆瓣酱小火炒出红油。
加小半碗水煮开，放入豆腐轻推，煮约5分钟。
分次淋水淀粉收浓，撒花椒粉和葱花。
recipes.note: 豆瓣酱较咸，先尝味再补盐。

en.title: Mapo tofu
steps: Cube tofu and blanch in lightly salted water. Mix starch with water.
Fry the pork until cooked. Add ginger, garlic and bean paste; gently fry until fragrant.
Add a small half-bowl of water and bring to a simmer. Add tofu and simmer for about 5 minutes without breaking it.
Thicken gradually with starch slurry. Finish with Sichuan pepper and spring onion.
en.note: Taste before adding salt; the bean paste is already salty.

recipes.title: 宫保鸡丁
steps: 鸡胸肉切丁，用少许生抽和淀粉腌10分钟；花生炒熟备用。
生抽、香醋、糖、少许水和淀粉调成碗汁。
炒香干辣椒和花椒，加入鸡丁炒至熟透。
加入葱段和碗汁翻炒收浓，最后放花生。
recipes.note: 花生最后下，保留酥脆。

en.title: Kung pao chicken
steps: Dice the chicken and marinate with a little soy and starch for 10 minutes. Toast the peanuts.
Mix soy, vinegar, sugar, water and starch into a sauce.
Sauté dried chillies and peppercorns; add the chicken and cook through.
Add spring onion and sauce. Reduce briefly, then fold in peanuts.
en.note: Add the peanuts last to keep them crisp.

recipes.title: 虾仁滑蛋
steps: 虾仁擦干，加少许盐和淀粉拌匀。鸡蛋加盐及一小勺水打散。
热锅少油，将虾仁炒至熟透后盛出。
锅中补少许油，倒入蛋液，中小火轻推。
蛋液将凝固时加入虾仁，炒至蛋液凝固，撒葱花。
recipes.note: 避免长时间翻炒，鸡蛋更嫩。

en.title: Silky eggs with prawns
steps: Pat prawns dry and coat with a little salt and starch. Beat eggs with salt and a teaspoon of water.
Stir-fry prawns in a little oil until cooked through, then remove.
Add a little more oil and the eggs. Gently push them together over medium-low heat.
Fold in prawns as the eggs begin to set. Cook until set and finish with spring onion.
en.note: Keep the cooking time short for tender eggs.

recipes.title: 糖醋里脊
steps: 里脊切条，加盐和少许蛋液拌匀，裹淀粉。
油温适中时分批炸熟，捞出；升温后短时复炸至表面酥脆。
另锅将番茄酱、糖、香醋和少量水煮开。
倒入肉条快速裹汁，撒白芝麻。
recipes.note: 油炸时分批下锅，挂汁后及时食用。

en.title: Sweet & sour pork strips
steps: Cut pork into strips, season with salt and a little beaten egg, then coat in starch.
Fry in batches until cooked. Remove, then briefly refry at higher heat until crisp.
Simmer ketchup, sugar, vinegar and a little water in a separate pan.
Toss pork quickly in the sauce and finish with sesame.
en.note: Fry in small batches and serve soon after coating.

recipes.title: 葱烧豆腐
steps: 豆腐切厚片擦干，大葱切段。
豆腐两面煎黄，盛出备用。
原锅小火煎香葱段，加入生抽、蚝油、糖和半碗水。
放回豆腐，小火煨8分钟至入味，收汁出锅。
recipes.note: 豆腐先煎定型，更容易吸收葱香酱汁。

en.title: Tofu braised with leeks
steps: Pat tofu dry and cut into thick slices. Cut onions into sections.
Pan-fry tofu until golden on both sides and remove.
Gently fry the onions. Add soy, oyster sauce, sugar and half a bowl of water.
Return tofu and simmer for 8 minutes, then reduce the sauce.
en.note: Frying first helps the tofu hold its shape in the sauce.

recipes.title: 清炖狮子头
steps: 荸荠切碎，葱姜泡少量水。
肉末加入蛋、荸荠、淀粉、料酒、盐，分次加入葱姜水搅打上劲。
团成大肉丸，轻放入温水锅，小火煮至定型并撇沫。
砂锅铺白菜，放入肉丸及汤，保持微沸炖约50分钟至熟透，调盐。
recipes.note: 保持微沸，避免大滚把肉丸冲散。

en.title: Jiangsu lion’s head meatballs
steps: Finely chop water chestnuts and steep ginger and spring onion in a little water.
Mix pork, egg, chestnuts, starch, cooking wine and salt. Beat in the aromatic water a little at a time.
Shape large meatballs and lower into warm water. Simmer gently until set and skim.
Line a casserole with cabbage. Add meatballs and broth, simmer gently for about 50 minutes until cooked through, then season.
en.note: Keep the broth at a gentle simmer to preserve the meatballs.

recipes.title: 扬州炒饭
steps: 米饭拨散，火腿和胡萝卜切丁，豌豆焯熟。
鸡蛋炒散盛出，虾仁炒熟。
炒香胡萝卜和火腿，加入米饭翻炒至松散。
加入豌豆、鸡蛋和虾仁，炒匀调盐，撒葱花。
recipes.note: 熟米饭及时冷藏，炒饭时充分热透。

en.title: Yangzhou fried rice
steps: Break up cooked rice. Dice ham and carrot; blanch peas.
Scramble eggs and remove. Stir-fry prawns until cooked.
Stir-fry carrot and ham, then add rice and separate the grains.
Add peas, eggs and prawns. Toss, season with salt and finish with spring onion.
en.note: Refrigerate cooked rice promptly and reheat thoroughly.

recipes.title: 龙井虾仁
steps: 龙井茶用温热水泡开，留少量茶汤及嫩茶叶。
虾仁擦干，以盐、蛋清和淀粉上浆。
温油将虾仁滑炒至熟。
淋少量茶汤和料酒，加茶叶快速翻匀。
recipes.note: 茶汤少量加入，突出清香而非苦涩。

en.title: Longjing tea prawns
steps: Steep tea in warm water. Reserve a little tea and some tender leaves.
Pat prawns dry and coat with salt, egg white and starch.
Gently stir-fry prawns in warm oil until cooked.
Add a little tea and cooking wine, then toss briefly with the tea leaves.
en.note: Use only a little tea to keep the flavour delicate.

recipes.title: 海蛎煎
steps: 海蛎挑去碎壳、轻洗沥干，蒜苗切碎。
淀粉加少量水调成稠浆，拌入海蛎、蒜苗、盐和白胡椒。
平底锅放油，倒入海蛎浆摊平，中小火煎至定型。
淋入蛋液，两面煎至金黄、海蛎完全熟透。
recipes.note: 海蛎务必熟透；翻面可借助盘子。

en.title: Fujian oyster omelette
steps: Remove shell fragments from oysters, rinse gently and drain. Chop garlic shoots.
Mix starch with a little water into a thick batter. Fold in oysters, shoots, salt and white pepper.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Spread the batter and cook gently until set.
Pour over beaten eggs and cook both sides until golden and the oysters are fully cooked.
en.note: Cook oysters thoroughly. Use a plate to help turn the omelette.

recipes.title: 沙茶拌面
steps: 黄瓜切丝，小葱切末。
沙茶酱、花生酱和生抽加少许热水调顺滑。
面条煮熟，沥水后拌少许油。
倒入酱汁拌匀，放黄瓜丝和葱花。
recipes.note: 沙茶酱常含海鲜成分，选购时留意配料。

en.title: Shacha peanut noodles
steps: Shred cucumber and chop spring onion.
Loosen shacha sauce, peanut butter and light soy with a little hot water.
Cook noodles, drain and toss with a little oil.
Mix with the sauce and top with cucumber and spring onion.
en.note: Shacha sauce often contains seafood; check the ingredient list.

recipes.title: 香菇炖鸡
steps: 干香菇提前泡发洗净，鸡腿切块焯水后洗净。
锅中少量油炒香姜片，放入鸡块翻炒。
加料酒、生抽、香菇和热水，煮开撇沫。
小火炖约35分钟至鸡肉熟透、软嫩，调盐撒葱。
recipes.note: 用徽式山珍炖煮思路整理的家常版本；时间不含干香菇泡发。

en.title: Chicken & shiitake stew
steps: Soak and wash the mushrooms in advance. Chop chicken, blanch and rinse.
Sauté ginger in a little oil, then add chicken and stir.
Add cooking wine, soy, mushrooms and hot water. Bring to a boil and skim.
Simmer for about 35 minutes until the chicken is tender and fully cooked. Season and add spring onion.
en.note: A home-style version inspired by Anhui mushroom stews. Time excludes soaking the dried mushrooms.

recipes.title: 徽式家常烧豆腐
steps: 豆腐切块煎至金黄，五花肉、香菇和青椒切片。
肉片煸出油，加入姜和香菇炒香。
放豆腐，加生抽、老抽和半碗水，小火烧约10分钟。
加入青椒煮熟，尝味后收汁。
recipes.note: 这是便于家庭操作的徽式风味版本，不使用发酵毛豆腐。

en.title: Anhui-style braised tofu
steps: Cube and pan-fry tofu until golden. Slice pork, mushrooms and pepper.
Render the pork, then sauté ginger and mushrooms.
Add tofu, both soy sauces and half a bowl of water. Simmer for about 10 minutes.
Add pepper, cook through and reduce the sauce after adjusting seasoning.
en.note: An accessible home-style Anhui-inspired version using regular tofu.

recipes.title: 蘑菇烩饭
steps: 高汤另锅保温，洋葱切末，蘑菇切片。
黄油炒香洋葱和蘑菇，加入米略炒。
分次加入热高汤，不断搅拌，等吸收后再添下一勺。
煮约18至22分钟至米芯合口，关火拌入芝士，调盐和黑胡椒。
recipes.note: 米不必提前淘洗；高汤实际用量视米的吸水情况调整。

en.title: Mushroom risotto
steps: Keep stock warm. Finely chop onion and slice mushrooms.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter, then briefly toast the rice.
Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring and letting it absorb before adding more.
Cook for about 18–22 minutes until the rice is to your liking. Off the heat, stir in Parmesan and season.
en.note: Do not rinse the rice. Adjust the stock quantity to suit absorption.

recipes.title: 泡菜鸡肉炒饭
steps: 鸡胸肉切小丁，泡菜切碎。
鸡蛋煎熟备用；另将鸡肉炒至熟透。
加入泡菜炒香，倒入米饭炒散，加少许生抽。
炒至充分热透，撒葱花并盖上煎蛋。
recipes.note: 用泡菜汁调整酸辣度，先尝味再加盐。

en.title: Kimchi chicken fried rice
steps: Dice the chicken and chop kimchi.
Fry the egg and set aside. Stir-fry chicken separately until cooked through.
Add kimchi, then rice. Break up the grains and season with a little soy.
Heat thoroughly, add spring onion and top with the fried egg.
en.note: Use kimchi juice to adjust acidity and heat; taste before adding salt.

recipes.title: 番茄炒鸡蛋
steps: 番茄切块，小葱切末，鸡蛋打散。
热锅放油，倒入蛋液炒至凝固后盛出。
放入番茄炒软，加入鸡蛋翻炒，用盐调味，撒葱花出锅。
recipes.note: 番茄炒出汁再加入鸡蛋，味道更浓郁。

en.title: Tomato & egg stir-fry
steps: Chop the tomatoes and spring onion. Beat the eggs.
Heat oil in a pan. Scramble the eggs until set, then remove.
Cook the tomatoes until soft. Return the eggs, season with salt and finish with spring onion.
en.note: Let the tomatoes release their juices before adding the eggs.

recipes.title: 家常红烧肉
steps: 五花肉切块，冷水下锅焯水后沥干。
炒化冰糖，加入肉块翻炒上色。
加入生姜、生抽、老抽和热水，小火炖45分钟后收汁。
recipes.note: 选肥瘦相间的五花肉。

en.title: Homestyle braised pork
steps: Cut the pork belly into cubes. Blanch from cold water and drain.
Melt the rock sugar in the pan. Add the pork and stir to coat.
Add ginger, both soy sauces and hot water. Simmer for 45 minutes, then reduce the sauce.
en.note: Choose pork belly with an even balance of fat and lean meat.

recipes.title: 番茄罗勒意大利面
steps: 意大利面按包装时间煮熟，保留一杯面汤。
大蒜切碎炒香，加入切块番茄炖出汁。
加入面条、少许面汤翻拌，撒罗勒后调味。
recipes.note: 面条保留一点硬芯，口感更好。

en.title: Tomato & basil pasta
steps: Cook the pasta according to the package. Reserve a cup of pasta water.
Sauté chopped garlic, then add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a sauce.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water. Add basil and season.
en.note: Cook the pasta al dente for the best texture.

recipes.title: 清蒸鲈鱼
steps: 鲈鱼处理干净，两面划刀，铺姜片。
水开后上锅蒸8至12分钟，按鱼的大小调整，确保鱼肉熟透。
倒掉蒸出的水，铺葱丝，淋热油和生抽。
recipes.note: 蒸好后及时取出。

en.title: Steamed sea bass
steps: Clean and score the sea bass on both sides, then add sliced ginger.
Steam over boiling water for 8–12 minutes, adjusting for the size of the fish until fully cooked.
Discard the cooking liquid. Add shredded spring onion, then pour over hot oil and light soy sauce.
en.note: Remove from the steamer as soon as it is done.

recipes.title: 蒜蓉西兰花
steps: 西兰花切小朵洗净，大蒜切末。
沸水中加入少许盐，西兰花焯水后沥干。
炒香蒜末，加入西兰花翻炒，用盐调味。
recipes.note: 焯水时间不要过长，保留爽脆口感。

en.title: Garlic broccoli
steps: Wash and cut the broccoli into florets. Mince the garlic.
Blanch the broccoli in lightly salted boiling water, then drain.
Sauté the garlic, add the broccoli and stir-fry. Season with salt.
en.note: Keep the blanching time short so the broccoli stays crisp.

recipes.title: 青椒炒肉丝
steps: 猪肉切丝，用生抽和少许油拌匀。
青椒切丝，大蒜切片。
热锅炒熟肉丝，加入青椒与大蒜翻炒至熟，调味后出锅。
recipes.note: 大火快炒更香。

en.title: Pork & green pepper stir-fry
steps: Slice the pork into strips and mix with light soy sauce and a little oil.
Slice the peppers into strips and thinly slice the garlic.
Stir-fry the pork until cooked, then add peppers and garlic. Cook through and season.
en.note: Use high heat and keep the ingredients moving.

Brush a non-stick pan with 3g oil. Cook the chicken over medium-low heat until fully cooked.
Slice the cucumber and toss with the chicken and lemon juice.

Brush a non-stick pan with 3g oil. Cook the chicken through, then slice.

Mix egg, egg white and flour with a little water, then fold in the spinach and shrimp.
